Thales is a decentralized prediction market and options protocol. Thales runs on smart contracts on a public blockchain. Thales operates without a central intermediary.

DerivaDEX is a decentralized derivatives exchange. DerivaDEX offers perpetual futures. DerivaDEX runs on smart contracts on a public blockchain.

Injective is a layer-1 blockchain built for financial applications. Injective is built with the Cosmos SDK. Injective hosts decentralized exchange and derivatives applications.
